explanation_templates.Coccidiosis: Droppings pattern (texture/color, possible blood or mucus) consistent with coccidiosis as seen in similar training images. This is a visual pattern match, not a clinical diagnosis of internal symptoms.
explanation_templates.Salmonella: Droppings pattern (texture/color/consistency) consistent with salmonella as seen in similar training images. This is a visual pattern match, not a clinical diagnosis of internal symptoms.
explanation_templates.Newcastle: Droppings pattern consistent with Newcastle disease as seen in similar training images. IMPORTANT: Newcastle disease often also involves respiratory and neurological signs that this image-based model CANNOT see or assess - a greenish/watery droppings pattern alone is not sufficient for diagnosis; veterinary examination of the live bird is essential.
explanation_templates.Healthy: No visibly abnormal droppings pattern detected compared to training images.
